notes: Prices only: Élections Québec's live results file keeps only its latest state, and the Internet Archive holds three captures from election night (one before any box reported), so there is no count timeline and no model; accuracy and profit cannot be measured.

Prices: Polymarket 1-minute price history (YES token), 2026-10-05T22:00:00Z to 2026-10-06T16:00:00Z (18:00 to 12:00 EDT); a row is written only when the price changes (plus the last minute). Settled = price of the eventual outcome >= 0.9 from then to the end of the window.

Map: one final frame, the official final results file (isResultatsFinaux true). Colour = Parti Québécois share of PQ + Liberal votes. No prior: 2022 was held on 125 different circonscriptions and Élections Québec publishes no transposition onto the 2026 map. Frame extras: 'winner' (party code), 'margin' (winner minus runner-up, share of valid votes x1000).
Result: Parti Québécois 60, Quebec Liberal Party 39, Conservative Party of Quebec 19, Québec solidaire 9 seats (127).

Already settled when the price window opened (18:00 EDT, before polls closed): most-pq, most-plq, most-caq, most-pcq, premier-psp.

Official timing, coarse: the first archived capture of Élections Québec's live file with at least 1% of polling stations reported is stamped 2026-10-06T01:31:08Z (12,296 of 20,704; PQ leading in 60 of 127, short of the 64 needed for a majority); Polymarket's 'PQ wins a majority' market settled 'no' at 2026-10-06T01:30:00Z.
